vulnerable_code:
class SmartMeterChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    # Binds directly to meter serial without verifying user's utility account owns it
    stream_from "meter_telemetry_#{params[:meter_serial]}"
  end
end
diagnosis: SmartMeterChannel provides telemetry updates without verifying whether current_user is the billing account holder for the requested meter_serial. Any subscriber can monitor real-time electric power and water consumption patterns of neighboring households.
corrected_code:
class SmartMeterChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    meter = current_user.smart_meters.find_by(serial_number: params[:meter_serial])
    reject unless meter

    stream_from "meter_telemetry_#{meter.serial_number}"
  end
end
